title: Gradient Estimates for Neumann Semigroups on Manifolds with Boundary under Unbounded Curvature Conditions
summary: This paper establishes Bismut-type formulas and gradient estimates for Feynman--Kac semigroups on Riemannian manifolds with boundary, under geometric conditions formulated in terms of Ricci curvature $\mathrm{Ric}_Z \geq K$ and second fundamental form $\mathrm{II} \geq σ$ for potentially unbounded functions $K$ and $σ$. We then apply these formulas to derive pointwise gradient estimates for the Neumann semigroup under variable, possibly unbounded, lower curvature bounds.
